title: Show HN: Linux server management over SSH – written in Rust and Tauri
summary: ServerBox is a web-based Linux server management tool built with Rust and Tauri, providing a graphical interface for SSH-based server administration directly from the browser.
problem_solved: Simplifies Linux server management by offering a modern GUI alternative to traditional command-line SSH operations.
why_valuable: Makes server administration accessible to users who prefer visual interfaces while maintaining the power and flexibility of direct SSH access.
